Yes, that feels natural. I pressed + Add a note, typed my note, saved it, and it stayed right there on the card, clearly set apart as my own private context. Being able to jot down why I saved something and see it whenever I look at the bookmark is exactly what I wanted. Happy with it.

One thing for later, not a change to this screen: I'd like to add a little simple formatting to a longer note now and then — a line break or a bit of emphasis — and have it show up nicely. No need to handle it now; just keep it in mind.
